name: Env Var Owned-Keys Reconciliation
description: Whenever the cluster's desired env vars change (spec.config, spec.env, or a plugin/fleet controller live-patching NEO4J_PLUGINS or a fleet token onto the live StatefulSet), the cluster controller recomputes the container's env as owned-vars-applied plus foreign-vars-preserved, then re-stamps the owned-keys annotation so a later removal is detected without disturbing foreign additions.

effects.description: mergeEnvVars applies desired vars, drops names in the previously-owned annotation that are no longer desired, and preserves any foreign vars added by the Neo4jPlugin/Aura Fleet controllers.
Rewrites the owned-env-var-names annotation each reconcile so the next loop can distinguish a true removal from a foreign var it never owned.

name: Split-Brain Auto-Restart
description: When split-brain detection finds server pods whose SHOW SERVERS view disagrees with the majority cluster group (and the repair action is restart_pods), the operator automatically deletes the orphaned pods so the StatefulSet recreates them and they rejoin the majority, surfaced via SplitBrainDetected and SplitBrainRepaired/SplitBrainRepairFailed events.

effects.description: Deletes each orphaned pod identified by split-brain analysis; the StatefulSet controller recreates it so it can rejoin the majority cluster view.
Emits a SplitBrainDetected Warning event on detection, then a SplitBrainRepaired Normal event on successful repair or SplitBrainRepairFailed if a pod deletion errors.

name: Plugin Restores What Its Target Lost
description: When a Neo4jPlugin's target StatefulSet (a cluster's {name}-server, a standalone's {name}) is created or its pod template changes, the plugin controller re-checks every Ready plugin targeting it. If the template still carries what the plugin set, nothing is written and the plugin stays Ready; if something removed it (NEO4J_PLUGINS, a variable the plugin sets, a VerifiedDownload init container or volume), the plugin turns Installing, emits PluginMissing and writes it back, which restarts the servers — or, while the target is not Ready with every server available, turns Waiting and restores it once the target is. Values someone else gave the plugin's variables are left alone, and variables the cluster renders from its own spec are never overwritten.

trigger.fieldName: StatefulSet.spec.template (the target's server StatefulSet; a standalone's StatefulSet likewise)

effects.description: Ready stays Ready when nothing is missing; otherwise Installing until the restored servers are ready, then Ready again (Waiting first while the target is not Ready with every server available).

effects.fieldName: StatefulSet.spec.template (neo4j container env; initContainers and volumes)
effects.description: Writes back the missing NEO4J_PLUGINS entry, plugin variable, or VerifiedDownload init container and volumes (or, on a standalone, removes a leftover env copy of the plugin's neo4j.conf settings).
Emits a PluginMissing Warning naming what the StatefulSet no longer holds.

name: Plugin Install Waits For A Fully Available Target
description: While a Neo4jPlugin's target is not Ready with every server available — a cluster with a server down (Degraded condition True inside the grace period, or phase Degraded), or still forming, rolling or upgrading; a standalone not Ready — a plugin pass whose edits would change the target's StatefulSet does not write it, because the write restarts every server and a cluster short of one could lose its majority. The plugin is Waiting, looks again after RequeueAfter, and installs once the target is fully available. A pass with nothing to write, and a settled plugin with nothing missing, are not held.

effects.description: Waiting ("Waiting until … is Ready with every server available …") instead of Installing; Installing again once the target is.
Emits one PluginInstallDeferred Normal event when the wait starts (or one PluginMissing Warning that says it waits, for a Ready plugin whose target lost what it set).

name: Plugin CA Volume Follows The Target's Trusted CAs
description: When spec.trustedCASecrets of a Neo4jPlugin's target (cluster or standalone) changes, the target's own controller re-renders its JVM truststore, which changes the server pod template and re-queues every Ready plugin targeting it. A VerifiedDownload plugin then brings the shared plugin-ca volume (an optional projection of each listed Secret, mounted at /etc/plugin-ca by every VerifiedDownload init container of the target) in line with the list: added when the list stops being empty, replaced when it projects other Secrets, keys or paths, removed with the init container's mount when the list is cleared and nothing else mounts it. The plugin controller is the volume's only writer; the cluster and standalone controllers keep it as a volume they did not render. A list that is only reordered, or a volume that differs only in what the API server defaulted or in an earlier operator's required projections, is not written. The write restarts the servers, so it waits like an install until the target is Ready with every server available.

effects.fieldName: StatefulSet.spec.template (plugin-ca volume; VerifiedDownload init containers' mount of it)
effects.description: Writes the plugin-ca volume for the new list, and the init container's mount of it when the list stops or starts being empty, in one StatefulSet update.

Installing ("Updating the plugin's trusted CAs: spec.trustedCASecrets of … changed (…)") until the restarted servers are ready, then Ready; Waiting first while the target is not Ready with every server available.
No PluginMissing Warning — the user changed the list. One PluginInstallDeferred Normal event if the update has to wait for the target.
